dedupe_keys.name: climactor city and region climate network participation data

description: ClimActor combines city and regional participation in transnational climate initiatives with contextual fields and two name-cleaning dictionaries. The Figshare collection links three CSV member items, including a dataset for more than 10,000 subnational governments. It can supply actor participation or institutional-network inputs to municipal climate-policy and infrastructure-transition simulations. Participation records do not prove that pledged actions were funded, built or effective, and actor names need careful matching across languages and jurisdictions. Each own member page states CC0, although the parent collection DOI registry says CC BY 4.0; the draft follows the data items' rights. I read collection and member metadata and the Scientific Data article without downloading the CSV files. The related ClimActor R package is a separate G1 software item for cleaning names. No exact catalogue coverage was found.
